permission_grants_scope_id_present.name: permission_grants_scope_id_present
permission_grants_scope_id_present.value: ("permission_grants"."scope_type" = 'platform' and "permission_grants"."scope_id" is null) or ("permission_grants"."scope_type" in ('kosk', 'madrasah') and "permission_grants"."scope_id" is not null) or "permission_grants"."scope_type" = 'course'

permission_groups_scope_id_present.name: permission_groups_scope_id_present
permission_groups_scope_id_present.value: ("permission_groups"."scope_type" = 'platform' and "permission_groups"."scope_id" is null) or ("permission_groups"."scope_type" in ('kosk', 'madrasah') and "permission_groups"."scope_id" is not null) or "permission_groups"."scope_type" = 'course'

role_assignments_held_scoped_idx.name: role_assignments_held_scoped_idx
role_assignments_held_scoped_idx.where: "role_assignments"."revoked_at" is null and "role_assignments"."scope_id" is not null

role_assignments_scope_matches_role.name: role_assignments_scope_matches_role
role_assignments_scope_matches_role.value:
("role_assignments"."role" = 'MEDARIS_NAZIM' and "role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'platform')
        or ("role_assignments"."role" = 'KOSK_NAZIM' and "role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'kosk')
        or ("role_assignments"."role" in ('MEDRESE_BASMUDERRIS', 'MEDRESE_NAZIR') and "role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'madrasah')
        or ("role_assignments"."role" in ('MUDERRIS', 'DERS_NAZIR') and "role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'course')
